Menu

What guests order

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Coffee in the morning

Cypriot coffee, cappuccino with latte art and frappe. One guest recommends Cypriot coffee with homemade tahini pie on a Sunday morning.

Beer and drinks

Draught beer, gin and tonic, wine and ouzo in the evening. 20 reviews mention the beer.

Homemade lemonade

Guests mention the homemade lemonade, one calls it the most amazing.

Something to eat

Chocolate cake, burgers, toasts and meze with beer, from morning to night.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Backgammon

Boards are there to play. 6 reviews mention backgammon, one writes that many locals come here to play.

Rock music

Guests mention classic and Greek rock on the playlist.

Inside and out

There are tables inside and on the square by the church. 7 reviews call it a cozy place.

In the heart of Nicosia

Halara means relaxed, and that is how guests describe the place. It is at Faneromenis 72-74, next to the historic Faneromeni church, with wooden beams and lamps inside and mosaic tables on the square. One guest writes that it gets busy after 11 in the morning.

What guests say

Three of 523 Google reviews, 370 of them with five stars.

“Cypriot coffee during morning time with some homemade tachinopita is an absolute must on a sunny Sunday morning! This is a traditional coffee shop, very well located in the center of Faneromeni and it will get crowded after 11 in the morning.”
